title: Linguistic and Argument Diversity in Synthetic Data for Function-Calling Agents
abstract: arXiv:2601.17829v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The construction of function calling agents has emerged as a promising avenue for extending model capabilities. A major challenge for this task is obtaining high quality diverse data for training. Prior work emphasizes diversity in functions, invocation patterns, and interaction turns, yet linguistic diversity of requests and coverage of arguments (e.g., \texttt{city\_name}, \texttt{stock\_ticker}) remain underexplored. We propose a method that generates synthetic datasets via optimizing general-purpose diversity metrics across both queries and arguments, without relying on hand-crafted rules or taxonomies, making it robust to different usecases. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our technique via both intrinsic and extrinsic testing, comparing it to SoTA data generation methods. translated_title: 面向函数调用智能体的合成数据中的语言与参数多样性
translated_abstract: 构建函数调用智能体已成为扩展模型能力的一条有前景的途径。该任务的一个主要挑战是获取高质量的多样化训练数据。以往的工作强调函数、调用模式和交互轮次的多样性，但请求的语言多样性以及参数（如 \texttt{city\_name}、\texttt{stock\_ticker}）的覆盖范围仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种方法，通过在查询和参数两个层面优化通用多样性指标来生成合成数据集，无需依赖手工构建的规则或分类体系，因此对不同用例具有鲁棒性。我们通过内在和外在测试验证了该技术的有效性，并将其与最先进（SoTA）的数据生成方法进行比较。结果表明，我们在多样性方面优于基线方法，同时保持了相当的正确性。此外，当用作训练集时……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需手工规则或分类体系、通过在查询和参数两个层面优化通用多样性指标来生成函数调用智能体合成训练数据的方法，在保持正确性相当的同时显著提升了数据的语言与参数多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method that generates synthetic training data for function-calling agents by optimizing general-purpose diversity metrics over both queries and arguments without hand-crafted rules or taxonomies, achieving superior linguistic and argument diversity while maintaining comparable correctness.
